framings.title: Check release metadata consistency
framings.description: Check existing CITATION.cff, .zenodo.json, codemeta.json and scholarly-article.jsonld texts against what a paper.yaml projects. Reports every missing, unexpected and different value, absent or unparseable file, and any AI system credited as leading author or creator. Deterministic.
